reasoning.description: High-precision laboratory optical microscope broken down into structural base, arm, focusing controls, illumination system, mechanical stage, revolving objective lenses, and ocular eyepiece head.

components.name: Base Plate
components.description: Heavy cast metal base providing structural stability for the microscope assembly.

components.name: Lower Illuminator Box
components.description: Transmitted light LED illuminator mounted in the center of the base.

components.name: Microscope Arm
components.description: Rigid vertical frame support housing internal focusing tracks.

components.name: Coarse Focus Control Knob
components.description: Large outer adjustment wheel for rapid vertical motion of the stage.

components.name: Fine Focus Control Knob
components.description: Smaller concentric dial for precise micro-meter focal positioning.

components.name: Mechanical Stage
components.description: Flat precision platform supporting slide glass during observation.

components.name: Slide Holder Clip
components.description: Spring-loaded metal clip securing the glass specimen slide on stage.

components.name: Substage Iris Condenser
components.description: Lens assembly beneath the stage to focus illumination light onto the sample plane.

components.name: Optical Head Adapter
components.description: Top mounting hub connecting the optical tube assemble to the arm frame.

components.name: Revolving Nosepiece Turret
components.description: Rotating multi-lens nosepiece that allows switching between objective magnifications.

components.name: High Power Objective Lens (100x)
components.description: Primary high-magnification immersion oil objective barrel.

components.name: Monocular Eyepiece Tube
components.description: Angled body tube directing focused magnified light to the viewer.

components.name: Ocular Eyepiece Housing
components.description: Top ocular lens housing assembly for final visual enlargement.
